units.translation: — 1030 ⟦1⟧ exactly as at 406, 711; but ⟦2⟧ and no longer ⟦3⟧ as at 711.
⟦1⟧ with dative ⟦2⟧. 18. 24, 'to stand out with'; here now with what she gives, ⟦3⟧ (1020 etc.).

Two short strophes with antistrophes; the rhythms are dactylic, just as in the Frogs the exit-song imitated from Aeschylus (1524 ff.) consists of dactylic hexameters. Str. ⟦1⟧, 1 tetrapody ending in a spondee; 3 (like a refrain) likewise catalectic; V. 2 is either a pentapody or a catalectic tetrapody + dipody, – ⏑ ⏑ – ⏑ ⏑ –, – ⏑ ⏑ – –, cf. 534 f. — Str. ⟦2⟧, 2 acatalectic tetrapody cf. ⟦3⟧, 1 (the rhythm of 1 must first be investigated, since ⟦4⟧ can also be – ⏑ ⏑ –); 3 catalectic tetrapody cf. ⟦5⟧, 3; the refrain an anapestic paroemiac, in rhythm attaching itself to the preceding verse, but there is hiatus or syllaba anceps between them.

⟦1⟧ (Wellauer) seems grammatically inadmissible in the tragedians (since ⟦2⟧ 'to the ground' is also emended); since now ⟦3⟧ (in trimeter) ⟦4⟧ stands, and below here 1041f. ⟦5⟧ . . ⟦6⟧, so before ⟦7⟧, ⟦8⟧ and all the many other conjectures Meineke's ⟦9⟧ seems to deserve preference. ⟦10⟧ is present (to ⟦11⟧), not aor. = ⟦12⟧, Kühner-Blass II 382. — As ⟦13⟧ the Eumenides have shown themselves greatly, and this is no reproach. Dindorf, however, explains here venerabiles, and ⟦14⟧ (⟦15⟧) venerabundus (I prefer 'gladly honoring').

⟦1⟧ as ⟦2⟧ 457, ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧ (ships that are no longer ships, but destroyed); so one probably understands here too: those who are no longer children (but old women). Simpler yet and more obvious is 'childless' (Ddf.), pointing to the isolation of the dread goddesses (69). I cannot take offense at ⟦5⟧ (⟦6⟧ L. Dindorf, Burney), and this form of the verse is more recommended by the antistrophe. ⟦7⟧ 433, exactly i.e. just; also ⟦8⟧ would have to be 'well-thinking' and not 'well-disposed'. V. 1035, which interrupts the connected construction 1032f., 1036f., and correspondingly the other closing verses of the strophes are assigned by Kirchhoff to a herald; there certainly was a difference in the speaker or speakers. ⟦9⟧ Kirchhoff takes as an explanatory addition that has displaced the genuine ⟦10⟧ = 1039; however Hermann's ⟦11⟧ is actually no change and is supported by ⟦12⟧ Frg. 121. This then goes to the rest of the people.
